text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am the Empress, Air Groove. I aim to
embody the ideals of all
Umamusume and
serve as a guiding beacon for all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Empress" is more than just a title to Air
Groove. It's an aspiration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't claim to fully understand what
that
aspiration entails, but I can
tell I've taken
a step closer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay! Thank you for sharing that. I'll
give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're right! Thank you, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I recall the satisfied looks on her fellow
students' faces, but more
importantly, the
gentle warmth that radiated from her
own...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that supporting her fellow
students is very important to Air Groove,
both through her student council
activities and her personal
mentoring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that case...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? My training regimen? You'll look
over it in place of Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wow—thank you very much! Oh, so about
this part on hamstring
exercises...

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
Man, these documents are really giving me
a headache. Maybe I
should ask the vice
prez about them...

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? You'd be a lifesaver! I wasn't
sure how to tally up the
votes here...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey. Just what do you think you're doing?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't play dumb. Do you think I wouldn't
notice that you've been
snatching up my
student council tasks and student
appointments?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What are you trying to say? That I should
just stay in my lane and
focus on racing?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well? Answer me!
And if I don't like what I
hear, our contract is over!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: To... help me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that I want her to let me help
with her various activities, so
that she can
devote more time to training without
giving up on any of them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Me, rely on you? You could stand
to be a little more
dependable before
suggesting such a thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Our contract will remain effective.
That is
all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A sturdy scepter to support my weight as I
walk my royal path...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So that is a trainer's role...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continue to take on some of Air Groove's
tasks where I can, and in
return she applies
herself to her training with greater vigor
than ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And at last, the day of the maiden race
that we have been preparing
for arrives.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
After a beautiful start,
she's pushed all the
way forward to the front of the pack—it's
today's favorite, Air Groove! Can she
shake off her debut race loss?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's not slowing down! She's fast! Air
Groove widens her lead! She's
in a league
of her own!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What a finish! Our winner comes in at an
overwhelming five lengths
ahead of her
competition!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The curtains are rising on the legendary
reign of the Empress, Air
Groove!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after her stunning victory, I
receive a text from Air Groove
letting me
know that she needs my help with
something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I grab my things in a rush and head over.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There you are. Wait... Why on earth are
you so out of breath?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. The seeds I ordered have
finally arrived, so let's get
started.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Flower seeds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The seeds, it turns out, are destined for
the flower beds behind the
main school
building. We begin the task of planting
them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how many times do I have to tell
you?! You're covering those
seeds with
way too much soil!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Take your time and do each step properly.
These seeds are way too
fragile for you to
be rushing through this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a few mishaps and a fair bit of
scolding, we just about manage
to wrap up
the planting before sundown.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All right, that should do. I'm looking
forward to seeing them bloom.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What, are you trying to say that's
unexpected of me or something? It's

written all over your face.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When given the care and attention that
they need, the buds emerge
strong and go
on to bloom beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The cycle repeats as new buds grow—a
testament to perseverance
and aspiration.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It was the sight of my own mother running
on the turf that allowed me
to bloom into
who I am.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the G1 Japanese Oaks
inherits the title of "Queen of
the Oaks."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My mother was able to rise above the rest
and ascend the throne as a
queen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When I learned about that legendary race
and just how hard she
fought for the title...
I was shaken to my very core. The seeds of
 aspiration were sown.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I dreamt of following in her footsteps—of
surpassing my limits, setting
foot into the
world of racing, and claiming victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And more than anything, I knew I wanted
to continue the cycle and
inspire others,
just as she inspired me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's why I chose to embrace the title of
"Empress." I wish to become
one who is
looked upon by all Umamusume as an
ideal to strive for.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To be as one like my very own mother—to
bloom mightily and
elegantly as a sign of
hope for the future.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And for that, simply winning races won't
suffice. I need to prepare the
soil of this
academy well, so that the seeds that
follow after me may grow strong.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If my trainers see no value in those
seeds,
then I have no need for a
trainer—or so I
thought...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But you... well. I suppose you may have
earned a little—just a tiny bit,
mind
you—of my t-trust...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shut it! You've got to be the worst
gardener I've ever met!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I was entirely too quick to bring up
this metaphor.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Knock it off with the tomfoolery!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her harsh words, I get the feeling
her attitude toward me has
changed, if
only slightly.
